categories.main_business_segments: Nine Dragons Paper (Holdings) Limited primarily operates in the manufacturing and sale of paper products, including packaging paper such as kraftlinerboard, testlinerboard, white top linerboard, coated linerboard, bleached folding boxboard, coated duplex board, high performance corrugating medium, printing and writing paper, gypsum board cover paper, and pulp. The Group also produces packaging products like corrugated cardboard, carton boxes, kraft paper bags, color printing products, and laminated paper products. Its operations include integrated pulp and paper production with a focus on high-end and differentiated paper products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs integrated pulp and paper production technologies, including chemical pulp, recycled pulp, and wood fibre processing. It uses advanced manufacturing equipment such as Germany’s BHS and Italy’s Fosber Pro/line corrugators, high-speed printing presses, and automated bag-making and forming machines. The Group emphasizes technological innovation, digital transformation using big data and AI, and lean operations to enhance efficiency, cost control, and product quality. It also focuses on environmentally friendly production methods and clean energy applications like gas-fired units and waste-to-energy incinerators.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves customers primarily in the packaging industry, including sectors such as food, pharmaceuticals, daily necessities, electronics, cosmetics, and logistics. It also caters to printing and writing paper markets, specialty paper users, and pulp purchasers. The majority of its revenue comes from the China market, accounting for approximately 88.7% of total revenue, with the remainder from international markets including the United States, Malaysia, Vietnam, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: Nine Dragons Paper operates mainly in China with multiple production bases in regions such as Beihai (Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region), Jingzhou (Hubei Province), Dongguan, Tianjin, Chongqing, Hebei, Leshan, Shenyang, and Hubei. It also has overseas operations and mills in the United States, Malaysia, and Vietnam. The Group’s registered office is in Bermuda, and it maintains a Hong Kong office for corporate functions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an integrated pulp and paper manufacturer, covering upstream raw material production (wood pulp, recycled pulp, wood fibre), midstream paper production, and downstream packaging product manufacturing. It controls a vertically integrated supply chain from raw materials to finished paper and packaging products, enhancing cost control and supply resilience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus is on achieving self-sufficiency in raw materials, expanding high-end paper production capacity, and promoting product differentiation. It prioritizes technological innovation, digital transformation, and lean management to improve efficiency and profitability. R&D efforts emphasize green products, lightweight and high-performance paper packaging, and environmentally friendly solutions aligned with market trends such as replacing plastic with paper.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of paper products and packaging materials, including kraftlinerboard, corrugating medium, coated boards, folding boxboard, printing and writing paper, specialty papers, and pulp. The Group also earns revenue from packaging products like carton boxes and kraft paper bags. Sales are made to industrial customers and distributors, mainly on a product sales basis.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nine Dragons Paper is positioned as the world’s largest paper-making group by production capacity and a leading integrated pulp and paper enterprise in China. It benefits from economies of scale, a stable customer base, and a diversified product portfolio. The Group competes by leveraging its vertical integration, technological innovation, and focus on high-end products to maintain market competitiveness and bargaining power. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB63.24 billion, a 6.3% increase year-on-year, with net profit soaring 177.3% to RMB2.2 billion. Total assets reached RMB149.04 billion, and total equity was RMB50.61 billion. The Group’s sales volume hit a record 21.5 million tonnes, up 9.6%. Capital expenditures increased to RMB14.83 billion to support capacity expansion. The Group has shown strong growth and resilience despite challenging market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nine Dragons Paper emphasizes integrated pulp and paper production to ensure cost control, supply chain resilience, and product quality. It differentiates through a broad and diversified product portfolio, including high-end, environmentally friendly, and customized paper products. The Group’s focus on technological innovation, digital transformation, and green manufacturing supports its competitive edge. Its large scale and vertical integration enable it to offer stable quality and maintain strong customer relationships.
